description: This file manages device pairing, including requesting, approving, rejecting, and token management for devices in a system. It handles state persistence, role and scope validation, and token verification.

classes.name: DevicePairingPendingRequest
classes.description: Represents a pending device pairing request with details such as device ID, public key, roles, scopes, and metadata.

classes.name: DeviceAuthToken
classes.description: Represents an authentication token for a device, including role, scopes, creation time, and revocation status.

classes.name: DeviceAuthTokenSummary
classes.description: A summarized view of a device's auth token, including role, scopes, and timestamps.

classes.name: PairedDevice
classes.description: Represents a device that has been paired, including its ID, public key, roles, scopes, tokens, and metadata.

classes.name: DevicePairingList
classes.description: Contains lists of pending and paired devices.

classes.name: ApproveDevicePairingResult
classes.description: Result of an attempt to approve a device pairing, indicating status and device info.

classes.name: DevicePairingStateFile
classes.description: Internal structure for storing pending and paired device states.

methods.name: loadState
methods.description: Loads the current device pairing state from disk.

methods.name: persistState
methods.description: Saves the current device pairing state to disk.

methods.name: normalizeDeviceId
methods.description: Trims and normalizes a device ID string.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Trims a role string or returns null if undefined.

methods.name: mergeRoles
methods.description: Merges multiple role strings or arrays into a unique list.

methods.name: listActiveTokenRoles
methods.description: Lists roles from active (non-revoked) tokens.

methods.name: listApprovedPairedDeviceRoles
methods.description: Returns roles approved for a paired device.

methods.name: listEffectivePairedDeviceRoles
methods.description: Returns effective roles considering tokens and approval.

methods.name: hasEffectivePairedDeviceRole
methods.description: Checks if a device has a specific effective role.

methods.name: mergeScopes
methods.description: Merges multiple scope arrays into a unique list.

methods.name: sameStringSet
methods.description: Checks if two string arrays contain the same elements.

methods.name: resolveRequestedRoles
methods.description: Resolves roles from input object.

methods.name: resolveRequestedScopes
methods.description: Normalizes requested scopes.

methods.name: samePendingApprovalSnapshot
methods.description: Checks if an existing pending request matches incoming request.

methods.name: refreshPendingDevicePairingRequest
methods.description: Updates an existing pending request with new data.

methods.name: resolveSupersededPendingSilent
methods.description: Determines if pending requests should remain silent based on existing requests.

methods.name: buildPendingDevicePairingRequest
methods.description: Constructs a new pending device pairing request.

methods.name: newToken
methods.description: Generates a new pairing token.

methods.name: getPairedDeviceFromState
methods.description: Retrieves a paired device from state by device ID.

methods.name: cloneDeviceTokens
methods.description: Clones the tokens object from a device.

methods.name: buildDeviceAuthToken
methods.description: Creates a new device auth token.

methods.name: resolveRoleScopedDeviceTokenScopes
methods.description: Filters scopes based on role prefix.

methods.name: resolveApprovedTokenScopes
methods.description: Determines approved token scopes based on device and request.

methods.name: resolveApprovedDeviceScopeBaseline
methods.description: Gets the baseline scopes for a device.

methods.name: scopesWithinApprovedDeviceBaseline
methods.description: Checks if requested scopes are within the device's baseline.

methods.name: listDevicePairing
methods.description: Lists all device pairings (pending and approved).

methods.name: getPairedDevice
methods.description: Retrieves a paired device by device ID.

methods.name: getPendingDevicePairing
methods.description: Retrieves a pending pairing request by request ID.

methods.name: requestDevicePairing
methods.description: Creates a new device pairing request.

methods.name: approveDevicePairing
methods.description: Approves a pending device pairing request.

methods.name: approveBootstrapDevicePairing
methods.description: Approves a device pairing using bootstrap profile.

methods.name: rejectDevicePairing
methods.description: Rejects a pending device pairing request.

methods.name: removePairedDevice
methods.description: Removes a device from paired devices.

methods.name: updatePairedDeviceMetadata
methods.description: Updates metadata for a paired device.

methods.name: summarizeDeviceTokens
methods.description: Provides a summary of device tokens.

methods.name: verifyDeviceToken
methods.description: Verifies a device token's validity and scopes.

methods.name: ensureDeviceToken
methods.description: Ensures a device token exists or creates a new one.

methods.name: resolveDeviceTokenUpdateContext
methods.description: Resolves context for token issuance or rotation.

methods.name: rotateDeviceToken
methods.description: Rotates a device's token.

methods.name: revokeDeviceToken
methods.description: Revokes a device token.

methods.name: clearDevicePairing
methods.description: Clears device pairing from state.
